Show the journal of adb commands and their inverses

Usage:
  adbuddy journal [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy journal
  adbuddy journal --session current
  adbuddy journal --session s_01J… --json
  adbuddy journal --limit 0 --json | jq '.data.entries[] | select(.level=="red")'

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for journal
      --limit int          show only the last N entries (0 = all) (default 50)
      --session string     only this session: its id (s_…), or current for the one serve is running now
      --workspace string   agent environment (default: the one 'adbuddy serve' is watching, else ~/ADBuddy/default)

Global Flags:
      --json   machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
